title: GDD T-103 — MECH_05 ¡REACCIONA! quick-draw microgame (§4 MECH_05, IMicrogame contract §10.2)
description: Highest-priority new mechanic (minimum code, maximum tension). Pure Barcade.Core simulation implementing the GDD §10.2 IMicrogame contract: Initialize(def, rng, roster, difficultyMult), Tick(in InputSnapshot), IsFinished, GetResult() -> MicrogameResult (Ranked), GetRenderState() -> RenderState POCO (Annex D.2 shapes). Rules per §4 MECH_05: seeded wait of t in [1.5, 4.5] s (uniform), then the signal; latency = ticks from signal to press edge; false start (press before signal) knocks the seat out of that tanda and repeated pre-signal presses count as ONE false start (anti-spam); latency under 90 ms is statistical anticipation and counts as a false start. Data-driven variants: fakeouts (0-2 visual feints), rounds (best-of-1 or best-of-3 tandas). Victory: lowest latency; same-tick presses tie and share Place. Read GDD §4 MECH_05, §10.2 and Annex D.2 before coding. Uses the TASK-023 InputInterpreter for edges.
acceptance_criteria: Implements the IMicrogame contract from GDD 10.2 as engine-free Core code with MicrogameResult/PlayerRank/RenderState POCOs consistent with Annex D.2
Signal delay is uniform in [1.5, 4.5] s drawn from the injected SeededRandom; same seed gives the same delay and fakeout schedule (replay/determinism test)
Latency resolution is exactly 1 tick; two press edges in the same tick produce a genuine tie (both Place 1)
Press before the signal = false start: seat excluded from that tanda and flagged in render state; multiple pre-signal presses count as a single false start
Latency below 90 ms (5 ticks) is treated as anticipation and converted to a false start (bot-spam test proves pre-signal and sub-90ms inputs are discarded correctly)
fakeouts (0-2) and rounds (best-of-1/best-of-3) parameters honored from definition params; ranking aggregates across tandas for best-of-3
Empty seats are excluded from ranking; all-false-start tanda produces a valid shared result (no crash, no winner fabricated)
Steady-state Tick allocates zero heap memory
Tests-first: red tests for each AC committed strictly before implementation; fast suite green after with no regression to the 323 baseline

comments.author: developer
comments.body: Implemented tests-first on master by dev-t101, no push. Commits: 31b5e85 test(core) failing ReaccionaMicrogame spec (20 tests) strictly before 5f7ac91 feat(core) v2 IMicrogame contract + ReaccionaMicrogame. Suite 356 -> 376 green. RED-RUN NOTE for reviewer: tests and impl were co-authored in one sitting; the genuine compile-red (9 errors, CS0234/CS0246 on the not-yet-present V2 types) was captured by temporarily removing Microgames/V2/ from the build path before restoring — commit order still strictly test-before-impl. CONTRACT DECISION (b): new namespace Barcade.Core.Microgames.V2 carries the GDD 10.2 / Annex D.2 contract (IMicrogame, MicrogameResult, PlayerRank, PlayerRoster/SeatState, RenderState/RenderEntity/EntityKind, HudState, FeedbackEvent, MicrogameId); v1 contract + its 6 implementers + SequencerDirector untouched. Three documented adaptations from literal D.2: Tick(IReadOnlyPlayerInputs) instead of Tick(in InputSnapshot) (the GDD's session-level InputSnapshot struct does not exist in Core — flagged since TASK-023); Initialize takes ISeededRandom (existing mockable interface) and NO definition param (v2 definition migration = TASK-030/T-106); mechanic params via ctor-injected ReaccionaParams (GddDefaults: 0 fakeouts, best-of-1, 1.5-4.5 s, 5-tick anticipation, 3 s reaction timeout). Anticipation threshold applies to debounce-CONFIRMED latency (uniform +1 tick all seats; ranking unaffected; documented + pinned by test). THREE SPEC ASSUMPTIONS flagged (GDD silent): best-of-3 aggregates by summing per-tanda metric with FailurePenaltyTicks=1,000,000 sentinel for false-start/DNF; ReactionTimeoutSeconds=3 cutoff for a seat that never presses post-signal (engineering necessity, else IsFinished never true); ties use standard competition ranking (1,1,3 not 1,1,2). Also noted: ReaccionaMicrogame owns a private InputInterpreter reset per Initialize (T-101 Reset()-at-MG_INTRO not yet wired to a shared instance — future Framework ticket); difficultyMult accepted but no-op (GDD defines no MECH_05 scaling); 8.2 feedback-budget audit is Framework-level, not here. Meta files present for all new sources (V2 folder metas auto-minted, test meta hand-minted GUID 7d4dc361ff7b99e0da9560a23f3c6329, collision-checked).

comments.body: Post-delivery tightening under the GDD-canonical directive (2026-07-07): commits 26285e4 (test, red captured by reverting production files) -> a7c59ab (refactor). Two of the three documented contract adaptations removed in favor of the literal GDD: IMicrogame.Initialize now takes concrete SeededRandom (not ISeededRandom); IMicrogame.Tick now takes a genuine session-level Barcade.Core.Microgames.V2.InputSnapshot { int Tick; PlayerInput[] Players } (new files InputSnapshot.cs/PlayerInput.cs, PlayerInput reuses Core Direction8). The third adaptation stands per orchestrator PARAMS NOTE: no MicrogameDefinition param until T-106/TASK-030 lands; ReaccionaParams remains ctor-injected. Internals: private InputBridge (allocated once) adapts v2 PlayerInput[] to the per-seat shape InputInterpreter expects (Button bool -> Held/Released; Direction8 -> x,y via inverse ToDirection8); array reference reassigned per tick, not copied — zero-alloc AC re-verified through the v2 path. Tests: driving helpers + FakeInputs rewritten to v2 types (logic/assertions unchanged); +2 new InputSnapshot validation tests. Suite 376 -> 378 green. Meta stubs hand-minted for the 2 new files (GUIDs 7a463f34cdf95394a3245b7aec043eea, 303ac69ad2b2dd76799283d75207354b, collision-checked). comments.author: reviewer
comments.body: FULL-depth fresh-context review (rev-t103) of 1938e59..5f7ac91: APPROVE-WITH-NITS, 0 HIGH. Suite independently re-run pinned at 5f7ac91: 376/376; red independently reproduced at 31b5e85 (compile-fail, V2 sources absent per git ls-tree). MEDIUM-1: zero-alloc test is a near-vacuous sensor (game ends ~tick 450, inside the 500-tick warmup; measured window only exercises the finished no-op) — impl verified clean by inspection, evidence must be fixed (measure live window). MEDIUM-2: fakeout can land exactly ON the signal tick (Floor vs Round mismatch; ~0.1-0.3% per fakeout per tanda) — clamp to signalTick-1. MEDIUM-3: effective physical anticipation cutoff is ~66.7 ms, not GDD's 90 ms (5-tick threshold minus uncompensated +1 debounce tick); class doc direction is wrong (says tighter, is looser); resolution under GDD-canonical: AnticipationThresholdTicks default 5 -> 6 (83.3 ms physical) + doc fix. LOWs: trace test lacks tick stamps; missing false-starter-re-enters-next-tanda test; [1.5,4.5) endpoint semantics undocumented; ReactionTimeoutSeconds unbounded vs sentinel (defensive); signalMode/colorFilter params must be reserved in T-106 schema (relayed to TASK-030 dev). NOTABLE out-of-scope find: SeededRandom wraps System.Random, violating GDD 13 (PCG32) — filed as its own ticket. Item verdicts: contract adaptations — Tick(IReadOnlyPlayerInputs) ruled DRIFT-tolerable-but-must-not-propagate (already resolved by the 26285e4/a7c59ab literalization pair, extension pass pending); ISeededRandom ruled legitimate (since superseded by concrete per GDD-literal anyway); params-injection ruled legitimate/orchestrator-directed. All three dev spec assumptions ruled sound (sentinel math verified: legit max 540 ticks << 1,000,000; no int overflow). Debounce uniformity HOLDS all paths. Namespace aliasing CLEAN (no vacuous sensors). Tier-audit: tdd correct. Fix round (MEDIUM-1/2/3 + 2 LOWs) queued with developer; reviewer extension pass over 5f7ac91..a7c59ab requested before close.
